tour.title: Project Overview & Documentation
tour.description: Start here to understand the campus placement portal architecture, backend Spring Boot setup, and frontend React configuration.

tour.title: Frontend Application Bootstrap & Routing
tour.description: The client-side single-page application mounts via main.jsx and configures all authenticated routes, dashboards, and role guards in App.jsx.

tour.title: Frontend API Communication Layer
tour.description: Handles HTTP communication with the Spring Boot backend, manages authentication tokens, and standardizes Axios request/response interceptors.

tour.title: Backend Core & Security Infrastructure
tour.description: Spring Boot application entry point with JWT filter chain and security policy configurations enforcing role-based access control.

tour.title: Backend REST Controllers & API Endpoints
tour.description: REST controllers that expose placement management, student profiles, job postings, and application processing endpoints.

tour.title: Business Logic & Service Implementations
tour.description: Service interfaces and implementations encapsulating business rules, candidate eligibility checks, and placement drive workflows.

tour.title: Data Persistence & Domain Entities
tour.description: JPA domain entities mapped to database tables alongside Spring Data repositories providing data access methods.
